name: WorkOrderDispatchQueue
tagline: The Work Order Dispatch Queue is the dispatcher's live list of open field-service jobs.
description: The Work Order Dispatch Queue is the dispatcher's live list of open field-service jobs. Every job is measured against its SLA due time: you see a countdown ("Overdue 2h 30m", "45m left"), a coloured badge (Breached, At risk, On track) and a bar showing how much of the SLA time has been used. Tiles across the top count open, breached, at-risk, unassigned and due-today jobs — and work as one-click filters.
features: SLA countdown and breach / at-risk banding against a configurable threshold
Clickable KPI tiles (open, breached, at risk, unassigned, due today), search
A phone card layout and Power Fx outputs and events for Patch
